name: Funding Reset Continuation
thesis: A trend that survives the flush of its own leverage is being driven by spot demand rather than borrowed money. When funding falls back from an extreme while price holds its trend structure, the weak leveraged hands have already been removed and the move can extend without their supply.
invalidation: Retire if worst-symbol out-of-sample profit factor stays below 1.0 over 30 trades, or if the mechanism's driving series stops being published.

provenance.author: quant
provenance.note: Entry thresholds loosened once for TESTABILITY: the original produced under 10 out-of-sample trades across 5 symbols, which is an absence of a verdict rather than a negative one. The mechanism is unchanged.

entry_long: prev(funding_z(1920), 32) > 1.0 and funding_z(1920) < 0.8 and close > ema(200)
